title: Normalized membrane ratio of TROP2 as a predictor of clinical outcomes with datopotamab deruxtecan in non-small-cell lung cancer
zh_title: TROP2归一化膜比值预测NSCLC中Dato-DXd临床结局
summary: 开发全监督计算病理方法TROP2 QCS，量化肿瘤细胞膜与胞质TROP2，提出归一化膜比值（NMR）用于预测Dato-DXd疗效。

abstract: Datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd)—a trophoblast cell surface antigen 2 (TROP2)-directed antibody–drug conjugate—has demonstrated efficacy in patients with advanced nonsquamous non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) ± actionable genomic alterations. However, TROP2 expression by pathologist assessment using conventional immunohistochemistry with visual scoring does not predict response to TROP2-directed antibody–drug conjugates in NSCLC. We developed TROP2 quantitative continuous scoring (QCS)—a fully supervised computational pathology approach that quantifies TROP2 expression in individual NSCLC cells and subcellular components from immunohistochemistry-stained slides. Using QCS to determine TROP2 expression at the tumor cell membrane and cytoplasm, normalized membrane ratio (NMR) was developed (ratio of membrane relative to membrane + cytoplasmic TROP2) in the biomarker-evaluable population of patients with advanced NSCLC in the TROPION-PanTumor01 study (n = 115). The TROP2 NMR cut-point was optimized and validated in patients with nonsquamous NSCLC without actionable genomic alterations (primary intended-use population, n = 221) in the biomarker-evaluable population (n = 352) of the TROPION-Lung01 trial. Association with clinical outcomes was assessed. Progression-free survival was longer in Dato-DXd-treated (median 7.2 versus 4.0 months; hazard ratio 0.40, 95% confidence interval 0.25–0.64) but not docetaxel-treated (median 4.1 versus 4.4 months; hazard ratio 0.94, 95% confidence interval 0.59–1.49) patients with TROP2 NMR-positive versus TROP2 NMR-negative samples (treatment by biomarker status interaction P = 0.0098), indicating that TROP2 NMR may be a predictive biomarker for Dato-DXd.
zh_abstract: Datopotamab deruxtecan（Dato-DXd）是一种靶向滋养层细胞表面抗原2（TROP2）的抗体偶联药物，已在伴或不伴可干预基因组改变的晚期非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中显示出疗效。然而，采用常规免疫组织化学结合目测评分、由病理医师评估的TROP2表达，并不能预测NSCLC患者对TROP2靶向抗体偶联药物的反应。我们开发了TROP2定量连续评分（quantitative continuous scoring，QCS）——一种完全监督式的计算病理学方法，可在免疫组织化学染色切片上对单个NSCLC细胞及其亚细胞结构中的TROP2表达进行定量。利用QCS测定肿瘤细胞膜和细胞质中的TROP2表达，在TROPION-PanTumor01研究中可进行生物标志物评估的晚期NSCLC患者人群（n = 115）中建立了标准化膜比值（normalized membrane ratio，NMR，即膜TROP2相对于膜+细胞质TROP2的比值）。在TROPION-Lung01试验可进行生物标志物评估的人群（n = 352）中，针对无可干预基因组改变的非鳞状NSCLC患者（主要预期使用人群，n = 221），对TROP2 NMR截断值进行了优化和验证，并评估了其与临床结局的关联。在接受Dato-DXd治疗的患者中，TROP2 NMR阳性样本患者相比TROP2 NMR阴性样本患者的无进展生存期更长（中位7.2个月对4.0个月；风险比0.40，95%置信区间0.25–0.64）；而在接受多西他赛治疗的患者中则无此差异（中位4.1个月对4.4个月；风险比0.94，95%置信区间0.59–1.49）（治疗与生物标志物状态交互作用P = 0.0098），提示TROP2 NMR可能是Dato-DXd的预测性生物标志物。

abstract: Heterogeneity within the tumor microenvironment remains a major obstacle to precision oncology. Although existing drug-sensitivity models can capture transcriptional heterogeneity, they generally do not account for the spatial organization of predicted drug responses. Here, we developed DeepTNR, a spatially resolved framework that integrates tumor-stroma interface features, spatial autocorrelation, and distance-dependent associations between local cellular composition and predicted drug sensitivity. Across nine tumor types, with colorectal cancer (CRC) as a representative example, DeepTNR identified irinotecan as the most sensitive drug and revealed significant spatial autocorrelation in its predicted response patterns. Spatial proximity effect analysis further showed that local enrichment of immune and proliferative programs positively was associated with increased irinotecan sensitivity. Together, these findings demonstrate the potential of DeepTNR to resolve intratumoral therapeutic heterogeneity and identify niche-specific vulnerabilities.
zh_abstract: 肿瘤微环境内的异质性仍是精准肿瘤学的主要障碍。尽管现有的药物敏感性模型能够捕捉转录异质性，但它们通常未考虑预测药物反应的空间组织。在此，我们开发了 DeepTNR，这是一个空间分辨框架，整合了肿瘤-基质界面特征、空间自相关，以及局部细胞组成与预测药物敏感性之间随距离变化的关联。在九种肿瘤类型中，以结直肠癌（CRC）为代表性示例，DeepTNR 识别出伊立替康是最敏感的药物，并揭示其预测反应模式存在显著的空间自相关。空间邻近效应分析进一步表明，免疫和增殖程序的局部富集与伊立替康敏感性增加呈正相关。总之，这些发现表明 DeepTNR 具有解析肿瘤内治疗异质性并识别特定生态位易感性的潜力。

abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Clinical documentation is a major contributor to physician workload and burnout, particularly in high-acuity settings such as emergency departments. Ambient AI scribes have emerged as a response, but commercial products cost US $99 to more than US $600 per physician per month, operate as opaque systems, and often process data on vendor-controlled infrastructure. These characteristics limit organizational control over data sovereignty, quality improvement, and clinical workflows and create barriers to adoption in resource-constrained settings. abstract: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge. Here, we show that Neuro-VL, a vision-language model trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care, can interpret complete imaging examinations and engage in natural language conversations about their findings. Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed frontier general-purpose and specialized medical models in diagnosing, localizing, and describing abnormalities, as well as generating comprehensive radiology reports. The model also compared serial examinations to assess disease progression and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions than leading frontier models from OpenAI and Google. These results extend health system learning beyond individual predictions to interactive image interpretation and longitudinal disease monitoring. They demonstrate how the collective clinical experience of health systems can be used to develop medical AI with specialized expertise and broad clinical capabilities.
zh_abstract: 医学影像对于疾病诊断、指导治疗以及长期监测患者至关重要。尽管人工智能已推进了影像判读，但现有医学模型往往只处理有限的任务，而通用的专有模型则无法获取实现医学专业水平所需的私有临床影像。开发能够解读复杂检查并在临床决策背景下传达其发现的模型，仍然是一项重大挑战。在此，我们展示了Neuro-VL——一种基于常规临床诊疗中近一百万例神经影像检查训练的视觉-语言模型，能够解读完整的影像检查并就其发现进行自然语言对话。在内部和国际数据集中，Neuro-VL在诊断、定位和描述异常以及生成完整的放射学报告方面，均优于前沿通用模型和专门的医学模型。该模型还能比较系列检查以评估疾病进展，并且相比OpenAI和Google的领先前沿模型，能更可靠地抵御误导性的临床假设。这些结果将卫生系统学习从个体预测扩展到交互式影像判读和疾病的纵向监测。它们展示了如何利用卫生系统的集体临床经验来开发具有专业水平和广泛临床能力的医学AI。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes are rapidly becoming normalized in clinical practice, yet governance frameworks focus on accuracy, privacy, consent, and medicolegal status. Risks to clinician capabilities have received less attention. Speak before the reveal is a proposed method in which clinicians verbalize critical cognitive steps, such as synthesis and plan, before note generation. Recent work distinguishes deskilling in senior clinicians, never-skilling from premature offload in trainees and mis-skilling, the internalization of AI errors and inappropriate use as sound practice. This Perspective builds on emerging evidence that reasoning before seeing AI output may protect unaided reasoning. Training implementation, evaluation, adherence challenges, validation methodology, and governance strategies for training bodies, health services, and scribe vendors are discussed. Speak before the reveal is a low-cost, testable approach to maintaining clinical reasoning for individuals or organizations. Successful AI scribe adoption requires preserving clinicians' ability to work without AI support.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 环境式人工智能（AI）抄录工具正迅速在临床实践中常态化，但相关治理框架主要关注准确性、隐私、知情同意和医疗法律地位，对临床医生能力所面临的风险关注较少。“揭示前先说”（Speak before the reveal）是一种拟议方法，即临床医生在生成病历之前，先口头表述关键的认知步骤，如综合分析和计划。近期研究区分了以下几种情形：资深临床医生的技能退化（deskilling）；学员因过早卸载认知任务而导致的从未习得技能（never-skilling）；以及错误习得技能（mis-skilling），即内化AI的错误并将不恰当的使用方式视为合理实践。本文为一篇观点性文章，基于越来越多的证据，即在查看AI输出之前先进行推理可能有助于保护独立推理能力。文中讨论了培训实施、评估、依从性挑战、验证方法，以及面向培训机构、医疗服务机构和抄录工具供应商的治理策略。“揭示前先说”是一种成本低、可检验的方法，可用于个人或机构维持临床推理能力。AI抄录工具的成功应用需要保持临床医生在无AI支持情况下工作的能力。

title: AI-monitored bioadhesive for sutureless microvascular anastomosis.

summary: Science研究提出微针互锁粘合系统，内置AI辅助无线传感器，可实时监测血流动力学并预测并发症。

abstract: [Science (New York, N.Y.)] Microvascular anastomosis, the surgical suturing of small-caliber blood vessels, is technically demanding, time-consuming, and prone to failure from complications such as thrombosis. Existing adhesives are ineffective in the dynamic, wet surgical field, particularly for the limited cross-sectional interface of blood vessels. We present an integrated microneedle-interlocking adhesive system (iMAS) bioinspired by plant root anchoring. This platform combines a hydrophobic polymeric matrix with tetrahedral microneedles, creating robust, three-dimensional bonding for rapid, secure anastomosis. An embedded artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted wireless sensor enables continuous, real-time monitoring of vascular hemodynamics and cardiac graft health, facilitating predictive identification of complications such as stenosis and transplant rejection. In rat models, iMAS reduced procedural time by 78% and suppressed neointimal hyperplasia. iMAS streamlines microvascular anastomosis and enables proactive graft monitoring in transplantation.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Orthopedic Image Analysis: A Systematic Review and Unified Taxonomy of Bone Age Assessment and Fracture Detection.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: 骨科影像AI：骨龄评估与骨折检测的系统综述与统一分类
summary: 基于PRISMA对2017–2025年116项研究进行系统综述，提出统一分类法，并指出评估不一致、外部验证有限、可解释性不足等问题。

提出按任务、模态、学习范式划分的统一分类法
指出外部验证有限、可解释性不足阻碍临床应用
reason: 系统综述纳入116项研究，但属综述类，封顶档内中位
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Bone age assessment (BAA) and fracture detection are essential tasks in orthopedic radiography, since they aid diagnosis and clinical decision-making in trauma treatment. Recent technologies in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning (DL), have enhanced the ability to analyze radiological images with greater accuracy and consistency. However, current studies are incomplete, with inconsistent evaluation methodologies, limited external validation, and insufficient interpretability, limiting clinical implementation. This study provides a systematic PRISMA-based review of 116 studies (2017-2025) that analyze imaging modalities, datasets, model architectures, evaluation techniques, and clinical relevance. A uniform taxonomy is introduced to define techniques based on task, modality, and learning paradigm, along with a comparative methodology to address inconsistencies across studies. The findings indicate that CNN and transformer-based models achieve MAE as low as 0.4-0.7 years and accuracy exceeding 95% in controlled datasets but are limited by dataset bias, poor generalization, and a lack of standardized benchmarks. Although explainable AI (XAI) approaches increase interpretability, their clinical reliability is still limited. This review synthesizes current methodologies, identifies key problems, and proposes future directions for AI systems that are robust, interpretable, and clinically deployable, while unifying BAA and fracture detection under a single taxonomy that integrates modality, task, and learning paradigm.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 骨龄评估（BAA）和骨折检测是骨科影像学中的重要任务，有助于创伤治疗中的诊断和临床决策。人工智能（AI）领域的最新技术，尤其是深度学习（DL），提高了分析放射影像的准确性和一致性。然而，目前的研究并不完整，存在评估方法不一致、外部验证有限、可解释性不足等问题，限制了其临床应用。本研究基于PRISMA对116项研究（2017–2025年）进行了系统综述，分析了影像模态、数据集、模型架构、评估技术及临床相关性。本文引入了统一的分类体系，按任务、模态和学习范式界定各类技术，并采用比较方法以解决各研究之间的不一致。结果表明，基于CNN和Transformer的模型在受控数据集中可达到低至0.4–0.7岁的MAE，准确率超过95%，但受限于数据集偏倚、泛化能力差以及缺乏标准化基准。尽管可解释AI（XAI）方法提高了可解释性，但其临床可靠性仍然有限。本综述归纳了当前的方法，指出了关键问题，并提出了面向稳健、可解释且可临床部署的AI系统的未来方向，同时将BAA与骨折检测统一于整合模态、任务和学习范式的单一分类体系之下。

title: Towards end-to-end LLM-based censoring-aware survival analysis.
zh_title: 面向端到端LLM的删失感知生存分析框架LLMSurvival
summary: LLMSurvival将事件时间预测改写为可比个体间的成对排序，使未修改的LLM可直接处理表格临床数据；在MIMIC-IV的ICU死亡和脆性骨折预测上，一致性指数较Cox模型略有提高。
key_points: 以成对排序处理删失，避免监督微调障碍
测试时与训练队列锚点个体比较，汇总得到风险

abstract: [Journal of biomedical informatics] Survival analysis is central to medical prediction, yet large language models (LLMs) are rarely used as end-to-end survival models because censoring prevents straightforward supervised fine-tuning. Here we present LLMSurvival, a framework that enables censoring-aware survival analysis with unmodified LLMs operating directly on tabular clinical data. LLMSurvival reformulates time-to-event prediction as pairwise ranking among comparable subjects, and derives test-time risk by aggregating comparisons against anchor individuals from the training cohort. Across two clinical tasks (ICU mortality prediction in MIMIC-IV and fragility fracture prediction in a NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medicine cohort), LLMSurvival improves overall concordance over Cox proportional hazards modeling by 3.1% for ICU mortality and 0.5% for fracture risk, and by 2.1% on average for ICU mortality and 2.8% for fracture risk over three established deep learning survival models. The results show that survival modeling with censoring can be made compatible with LLM fine-tuning through comparison-based reformulation. The framework demonstrates high portability and superior performance over expert-curated scores like SAPS-II and FRAX scores across diverse clinical contexts. Furthermore, the framework supports local deployment, as compact, publicly available base models provide sufficient performance. The LLMSurvival framework serves as a proof of concept for an integrated, censoring-conscious approach to survival analysis via LLMs.
zh_abstract: [Journal of biomedical informatics] 生存分析是医学预测的核心，但大语言模型（LLM）很少被用作端到端的生存模型，因为删失使得直接进行监督微调并不可行。本文提出LLMSurvival，这是一个框架，使未经修改的LLM能够直接基于表格型临床数据进行考虑删失的生存分析。LLMSurvival将事件发生时间预测重新表述为可比较受试者之间的成对排序，并通过将测试对象与训练队列中的锚点个体进行比较并汇总来得出测试时的风险。在两项临床任务（MIMIC-IV中的ICU死亡预测和纽约长老会/威尔康奈尔医学中心队列中的脆性骨折预测）中，LLMSurvival的总体一致性相比Cox比例风险模型，在ICU死亡率上提高了3.1%，在骨折风险上提高了0.5%；相比三种已有的深度学习生存模型，在ICU死亡率上平均提高2.1%，在骨折风险上平均提高2.8%。结果表明，通过基于比较的重新表述，可使含删失的生存建模与LLM微调相兼容。该框架表现出很高的可移植性，并在多种临床情境中优于SAPS-II和FRAX评分等专家制定的评分。此外，该框架支持本地部署，因为紧凑的公开基础模型即可提供足够的性能。LLMSurvival框架可作为通过LLM进行综合性、考虑删失的生存分析方法的概念验证。

title: AI-Integrated multimodal neuroimaging in Alzheimer's disease: toward biologically informed precision diagnostics.
source: PubMed · Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
zh_title: 阿尔茨海默病的AI整合多模态神经影像：迈向生物学导向的精准诊断
summary: 综述AI结合结构MRI、PET等多模态影像、分子与临床数据在阿尔茨海默病诊断与预后中的应用，指出单模态AI信息有限。
key_points: 结构MRI显示萎缩，PET检测Aβ/NFT沉积
单模态AI生物学信息有限，推动多模态整合

reason: 神经退行性多模态综述，综述类上限内，读者方向相关
abstract: [Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association] Alzheimer's disease (AD), which is characterized by the progressive accumulation of amyloid beta plaques and neurofibrillary tangles (NFTs), metabolic dysfunction, and neuroinflammation, is the most prevalent neurodegenerative disorder. The distinct pathological features of AD can be characterized in vivo via neuroimaging: Structural magnetic resonance imaging captures brain atrophy, while positron emission tomography detects Aβ/NFT deposition. The application of artificial intelligence (AI) can enhance the interpretation of neuroimaging data, but single-modality AI provides only limited biological information. This limitation has motivated the development of multimodal approaches that integrate complementary imaging, molecular, and clinical data for diagnosis and prognosis. However, there has been no comprehensive examination of how modality-specific neuroimaging information is incorporated into single-modality AI and subsequently integrated within multimodal frameworks. This review addresses this gap by evaluating conventional neuroimaging, single-modality AI, and multimodal AI as part of a unified framework, with particular emphasis on the added diagnostic and prognostic value of multimodal integration. We further identify key methodological and translational bottlenecks in developing clinically robust multimodal AI, including cross-modal and cross-cohort heterogeneity, model complexity, missing modalities, interpretability, and generalizability. Finally, we propose a translational roadmap emphasizing data harmonization, independent external validation, clinically meaningful explainability, and prospective evaluation. Ultimately, the clinical value of multimodal AI will depend on whether its added predictive value is reproducible across independent populations and translates into meaningful improvements in clinical decision-making and patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association] 阿尔茨海默病（AD）以淀粉样β斑块和神经原纤维缠结（NFT）的进行性积累、代谢功能障碍和神经炎症为特征，是最常见的神经退行性疾病。AD的特征性病理改变可通过神经影像学在体内进行刻画：结构磁共振成像可显示脑萎缩，而正电子发射断层扫描可检测Aβ/NFT沉积。人工智能（AI）的应用可增强对神经影像数据的解读，但单模态AI只能提供有限的生物学信息。这一局限促使人们发展整合互补的影像、分子和临床数据用于诊断和预后的多模态方法。然而，目前尚缺乏对模态特异性神经影像信息如何被纳入单模态AI并随后在多模态框架中整合的全面审视。本综述通过将传统神经影像、单模态AI和多模态AI作为统一框架进行评估来填补这一空白，并特别强调多模态整合在诊断和预后方面的附加价值。我们进一步指出了开发临床上稳健的多模态AI所面临的关键方法学和转化瓶颈，包括跨模态和跨队列异质性、模型复杂性、模态缺失、可解释性和泛化能力。最后，我们提出了一条转化路线图，强调数据协调统一、独立外部验证、具有临床意义的可解释性以及前瞻性评估。归根结底，多模态AI的临床价值将取决于其附加预测价值能否在独立人群中重现，并转化为临床决策和患者结局的切实改善。

title: CaseScope: A Multi-Field Benchmark for Case-Level Pathology Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs
zh_title: CaseScope：多视野病例级病理诊断的多模态大模型基准
summary: 提出病例级病理基准CaseScope，用同一病灶的多个视野评估多模态大模型的诊断能力。
key_points: Teaching子集436例，经WHO本体统一
Atlas子集800例，来自88本图谱
标签由两个LLM对图注一致标注
reason: 病理多模态LLM新基准，贴合读者方向，但为预印本且规模中等
abstract: Pathologists rarely diagnose from a single image: they scan a section at low power for architecture, zoom into selected fields for cytology, and integrate the evidence across views and scales. Pathology benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, mostly ask about one image or require whole-slide pipelines, and the few that show several fields draw nested regions from cancer slides of one public cohort. We introduce CaseScope, a benchmark of diagnosis from several curated fields of one lesion: CaseScope-Teaching, 436 cases from a residency-training image library, reconstructed, de-identified, harmonised against a WHO-based ontology and re-examined by a pathologist wherever an automated pre-review raised a doubt, and CaseScope-Atlas, 800 cases from 88 published atlases (387 of them figure series of one disease), labelled from the captions by two LLMs that must agree. They cover 843 entities across 18 organ systems and pose 4,679 items in six tasks, from open-ended and ten-way diagnosis with ontology-guided hard negatives under circular evaluation to the verification and location of morphological findings. Across twenty-eight open and four proprietary MLLMs, diagnoses are unstable -- the best open and proprietary models are correct under all ten option rotations on 17.9% and 61.7% of the teaching cases -- and wrong answers favour the classic look-alike; open models make little use of the additional fields on teaching cases, where the one-line specimen site matters more, although on atlas cases with three or more fields the fields count about as much as the site; and most open models verify findings barely above chance (median 62.0% vs. 50%, best 81.5%), gaining a median +3.4 points from images; proprietary models reach 83.2-93.2%. Rankings broadly replicate between the sources. The evaluation code is available at https://github.com/Wenchuan-Zhang/CaseScope.

title: MAGIC: Modality-Aware Gini Inspection for Clinical Hallucination Detection in LMMs
zh_title: MAGIC：基于模态感知基尼系数的医学多模态模型幻觉检测
summary: 以基尼系数量化多模态模型生成时视觉与文本token的注意力分配，发现幻觉回答存在显著的注意力再分配，并据此训练幻觉检测器。
key_points: 将幻觉检测表述为跨模态注意力分布失衡
用基尼系数衡量各层各头的模态注意力集中度
幻觉回答中视觉与文本注意力显著重分配
reason: 医学多模态模型幻觉检测新方法，预印本证据有限；命中多模态偏好
abstract: Recent advances in medical large multimodal models (LMMs) have brought promising progress to clinical decision support, yet hallucination, the generation of confident but clinically unverifiable outputs, poses a critical threat to the reliability demanded in high-stakes medical settings. Existing hallucination detection methods, predominantly designed for unimodal settings, fail to capture the visual-linguistic dynamics inherent to medical imaging. We formulate the problem of hallucination detection in LMMs as disproportionate distribution of attention weights across the modalities during answer token generation. We quantify modality-specific attention concentration across layers and heads using the Gini coefficient and demonstrate statistically significant redistribution of attention mass between visual and textual tokens in hallucinated responses. We leverage these features to train a logistic regression-based classifier and evaluate it on two medical LMMs across three medical imaging modalities, demonstrating that our method achieves competitive or superior performance against contemporary hallucination detection baselines.
zh_abstract: 医学大型多模态模型（LMM）的最新进展为临床决策支持带来了可喜的进步，然而幻觉，即生成看似自信但临床上无法验证的输出，对高风险医疗场景所要求的可靠性构成严重威胁。现有的幻觉检测方法主要针对单模态场景设计，无法捕捉医学影像中固有的视觉-语言动态。我们将LMM中的幻觉检测问题表述为在生成答案词元（token）时各模态之间注意力权重分布的不均衡。我们使用基尼系数（Gini coefficient）量化各层和各注意力头中特定模态的注意力集中程度，并证明在幻觉回答中，视觉词元与文本词元之间的注意力质量存在具有统计学显著性的重新分配。我们利用这些特征训练了一个基于逻辑回归的分类器，并在两种医学LMM、三种医学影像模态上对其进行评估，结果表明我们的方法与当代幻觉检测基线相比，取得了具有竞争力或更优的性能。

title: Science Prediction Universe
zh_title: 科学预测宇宙：实验结果预测基准
summary: 提出 SPU 基准，含化学、材料、生物和医学的100个公开任务及16个未发表湿实验私有任务，评估智能体对实验结果的预测排序。
key_points: 100个公开已验证任务
16个私有未发表湿实验任务
评估十三种智能体配置
reason: AI 科学发现类新基准，预印本，结果信息有限
abstract: Humanity has long sought to explain natural phenomena. Reliable prediction of experimental outcomes is a central test of our understanding of the processes that produce them. If artificial general intelligence (AGI) is to surpass human scientific capabilities, it must also predict experimental outcomes more reliably than humans. Such capabilities could accelerate scientific discovery across disciplines, help address humanity's most pressing challenges, and improve human well-being. We introduce Science Prediction Universe (SPU), a benchmark of hidden experimental outcomes with 100 public verified tasks from chemistry, materials science, biology and medicine, and 16 private tasks from unpublished wet-lab experiments. Given an experimental setup and candidate conditions, an agent works with any resources it needs to rank the candidates by a measured outcome. We evaluate thirteen agent configurations spanning twelve frontier models across two harnesses (Codex and Claude Code). Current agents remain far from saturating wet-lab outcome prediction, with substantial performance disparities across models: on the public benchmark, configurations separate into two distinct tiers, with task-adjusted Spearman correlations ranging from 0.227 for the lowest-performing configuration to 0.478 for the best. Analysis of 1,155 scored public trajectories (227,103 tool calls) suggests that the bottleneck lies in scientific judgment rather than tool execution: agents rely on shared monotone priors, agreeing far more with one another than with experimental reality (0.52 vs. 0.33), and frequently compute trivial physical or chemical proxies that do not influence the final outcome.
zh_abstract: 人类长期以来一直试图解释自然现象。可靠地预测实验结果，是检验我们对产生这些结果的过程是否理解的核心标准。如果通用人工智能（AGI）要超越人类的科学能力，它就必须比人类更可靠地预测实验结果。这类能力可以加速各学科的科学发现，帮助应对人类最紧迫的挑战，并改善人类福祉。我们提出了科学预测宇宙（Science Prediction Universe，SPU），这是一个隐藏实验结果的基准，包含来自化学、材料科学、生物学和医学的100项经过公开验证的任务，以及16项来自未发表湿实验的私有任务。给定实验设置和候选条件，智能体可使用其所需的任何资源，按测得的结果对候选条件进行排序。我们评估了13种智能体配置，涵盖12个前沿模型和两种运行框架（Codex 和 Claude Code）。当前的智能体距离在湿实验结果预测上达到饱和仍相去甚远，不同模型之间存在显著的性能差异：在公开基准上，各配置分为两个明显不同的层级，经任务校正的 Spearman 相关系数从表现最差配置的 0.227 到最佳配置的 0.478。对1,155条已评分的公开任务轨迹（227,103次工具调用）的分析表明，瓶颈在于科学判断而非工具执行：智能体依赖共同的单调先验，彼此之间的一致程度远高于与实验现实的一致程度（0.52 对 0.33），并且经常计算对最终结果没有影响的琐碎物理或化学代理指标。

title: Aggregate Accuracy Hides Diagnosis-Specific Failure in Medical Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 总体准确率掩盖医学视觉语言模型的特定诊断失败
summary: 在6048道ChestX-ray14问题上审计五个开源医学VLM，发现部分模型对气胸完全漏检，却仍给出流畅解释。
key_points: 两模型对432例气胸阳性检出为零
这两模型对864例气胸问题均答否
失败不受提示、分辨率或规模影响
reason: VLM 评测有启发，但为预印本、单数据集审计
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) are compared mainly by accuracy averaged across findings, a summary that can hide complete failure on a single diagnosis. We audit five open medical VLMs (MedGemma-4B, Lingshu-7B, HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and MedVLM-R1) on 6,048 ChestX-ray14 questions balanced by sex, age, finding, and label. On the 432 pneumothorax-positive X-rays, HuatuoGPT-Vision and Qwen2.5-VL detect zero cases while MedGemma and Lingshu detect 38% and 67% of the same images. The two failing models answer "no" to all 864 pneumothorax cases (balanced accuracy 0.500, chance), yet produce fluent, anatomically specific explanations that name the signs of a collapsed lung and then deny them, with no hedge or abstention. This failure is not an artifact of prompting, image resolution, label ambiguity, or model scale. It persists across four prompt formats, at native resolution, and on single-label cases. A within-model control shows the same forced prompt gives HuatuoGPT 79% recall on nodule but only 6% on pneumothorax. It survives a tenfold scale increase (Qwen2.5-VL-72B detects 4%) and replicates on SIIM-ACR, an independent dataset with radiologist-drawn masks, where the failing models detect 0 of 432 confirmed pneumothoraces, including 0 of the 144 largest lesions. Reading the models' logits and internal states shows this is not blindness. The two failing models are highly confident yet no better than chance and a linear probe recovers pneumothorax from their hidden representations even where recall is zero, so the finding is represented internally but suppressed at the output. Aggregate accuracy therefore cannot establish that a medical VLM can see a given finding, because a model that misses one can still describe it convincingly. Reporting per-finding recall and specificity on balanced cases is needed to tell the difference.

abstract: Postmarketing pharmacovigilance relies on spontaneous adverse event reporting and labor-intensive observational studies, which suffer from underreporting and delayed risk detection. Large language model (LLM) agents could automate real-world evidence generation, but generalist agents make ad hoc analytical decisions that compromise epidemiological validity and reproducibility. Here we present MedCheckpoint, a multi-agent LLM system for automated postmarketing pharmacovigilance. MedCheckpoint grounds each analytical stage in a curated, source-traceable medical knowledge base, locks core study-design parameters before execution, performs patient-level analyses with human-written deterministic statistical tools, and enforces checkpoint rules that abort infeasible analyses, with optional human-in-the-loop review. We evaluated MedCheckpoint using a 54-question benchmark on a dual-purpose simulated electronic health record (EHR) testbed of 2.7 million individuals, designed with reliable clinical signals to evaluate routine analytical accuracy alongside spurious signals to stress-test system rigor. Across the benchmark, MedCheckpoint outperformed two coding-agent baselines in report quality across five dimensions rated by three independent LLM judges (overall means 4.81-4.88 versus 4.25-4.55 and 4.02-4.29) and yielded higher run-to-run consistency (mean within-question standard deviation 0.116-0.186 versus up to 0.440). Crucially, while baselines failed on up to 2 of 21 runs when handling infeasible comparisons or unmeasurable outcomes, MedCheckpoint produced no misleading failures across all seven stress-test trap questions with known data limitations. MedCheckpoint enables reliable, auditable, and scalable pharmacovigilance analysis.

abstract: Contradictory claims about drug efficacy across randomized controlled trials (RCTs) complicate evidence-based medicine, yet existing automated methods classify isolated sentence pairs and do not explain why studies disagree. We present DrugCon, a large language model (LLM)-based framework that extracts study conclusions from RCT abstracts, links these claims when they concern the same drug-disease association, detects contradictions with counterfactual reasoning, and explains them using a taxonomy of ten study-level factors such as population, dosage, and outcome measures. Applying DrugCon to 224,756 RCT abstracts, we built DrugCon-Bench, an exhaustively annotated benchmark of 542 contradictory claim pairs from 819 abstracts. Most contradictions involve more than one study-level factor (75.5%). The most common are differences in outcome measures (64.0%), populations (51.3%), and dosage or exposure duration (35.6%). DrugCon achieves an F1 score of 0.744 for contradiction detection, outperforming rule-based, supervised, and natural language inference baselines, and an F1 of 0.482 for identifying explanatory study factors. DrugCon enables scalable and explainable analysis of contradictory clinical evidence.
zh_abstract: 随机对照试验（RCT）之间关于药物疗效的相互矛盾的结论使循证医学变得复杂，而现有的自动化方法仅对孤立的句子对进行分类，并不解释各研究为何不一致。我们提出 DrugCon，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架：它从 RCT 摘要中提取研究结论，在这些结论涉及同一药物-疾病关联时将其关联起来，通过反事实推理检测矛盾，并利用包含十类研究层面因素（如人群、剂量和结局指标）的分类体系对矛盾加以解释。将 DrugCon 应用于 224,756 篇 RCT 摘要，我们构建了 DrugCon-Bench，这是一个经穷尽标注的基准，包含来自 819 篇摘要的 542 对相互矛盾的结论。大多数矛盾涉及不止一个研究层面因素（75.5%）。最常见的是结局指标差异（64.0%）、人群差异（51.3%）以及剂量或暴露持续时间差异（35.6%）。DrugCon 在矛盾检测上的 F1 分数为 0.744，优于基于规则、有监督和自然语言推理的基线；在识别解释性研究因素上的 F1 为 0.482。DrugCon 可实现对相互矛盾的临床证据进行可扩展且可解释的分析。

abstract: Classification of lung adenocarcinoma into poorly differentiated (PD) and well-to-moderately differentiated (WMD) subtypes plays an important role in patient survival; however, consistent classification is difficult due to inter-observer variability among pathologists. Collecting data from multiple hospitals is also challenging due to patient privacy concerns. This study proposes a web-based federated learning system that shares only locally trained model weights without sharing patient data between institutions. The UNI2 foundation model and CLAM-SB were used to classify pathological whole slide images. A four-client federated learning system was constructed, and the NLST cohort was reserved exclusively for external validation. In centralized evaluation, joint training with CPTAC and TCGA outperformed single-institution training on external validation, confirming the necessity of multi-institutional data integration. FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, and FedNova were compared as federated learning algorithms under identical experimental conditions. Test AUC ranked as FedBN, FedProx, FedNova, and FedAvg. FedNova showed the most balanced classification performance between PD and WMD. L1-norm structural pruning at 20%, 30%, and 40% sparsity was applied to reduce model transmission size. FedAvg, FedProx, and FedBN showed a tendency of decreasing Test AUC under pruning, while FedNova achieved improved Test AUC across all sparsity levels. A web-based application was developed supporting slide upload, local training, AI classification, and attention heatmap-based visualization. The combination of FedNova and 40% pruning was confirmed as a practical approach that improves communication efficiency and classification performance while protecting patient privacy.

abstract: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. In particular, in one set of experiments, a language model was able to match standard gradient-descent training using 6times fewer training subjects, through reasoning alone and without any gradient descent step. Networks written by Claude Opus 5.5 also scored higher than classic hand-crafted EEG pipelines (alpha band power, and common spatial patterns with linear discriminant analysis) when built from the same 5 subjects. We also highlight some of the limitations, which include the inability of language models to improve already well-trained classification models, and their incapacity to reliably recognize, from the weights alone, the task a network was trained on. Overall, our results indicate that weight-space programming can be useful for small networks, such as those deployed on edge devices and wearables, but the concept still requires further investigation before it can be used in practice.
zh_abstract: 权重空间编程（weight-space programming）使语言模型能够读取已训练神经网络的权重并对其进行编辑。这为通过推理而非梯度下降来“训练”模型打开了大门。先前的研究已在博弈网络和修复语言模型特定故障方面展示了其功能与前景，甚至已扩展到扩散模型。在本研究中，我们展示了其在基于生物信号数据（具体为脑电图 EEG 和心电图 ECG 数据）训练的模型上的适用性。我们表明，前沿模型不仅能够在未被告知故障内容的情况下，调试基于生物信号的模型中被植入的特定故障，甚至能够仅凭网络架构、任务和极少量训练受试者，从零开始编写网络的全部权重。特别是在一组实验中，一个语言模型仅通过推理、不经任何梯度下降步骤，就能够以少 6 倍的训练受试者数量达到标准梯度下降训练的水平。由 Claude Opus 5.5 编写的网络，在使用相同的 5 名受试者构建时，其得分也高于经典的手工设计 EEG 流程（alpha 频带功率，以及共空间模式结合线性判别分析）。我们还指出了一些局限性，包括语言模型无法改进已充分训练的分类模型，以及无法仅凭权重可靠地识别网络所训练的任务。总体而言，我们的结果表明，权重空间编程对于小型网络（例如部署在边缘设备和可穿戴设备上的网络）可能有用，但该概念在能够实际应用之前仍需进一步研究。

abstract: [Pathologica] Neuroblastoma is the most common extracranial solid malignancy of childhood and demonstrates marked clinical and biologic heterogeneity. Histopathologic evaluation, particularly through the International Neuroblastoma Pathology Classification system, remains central to risk stratification by integrating patient age, degree of neuroblastic differentiation, Schwannian stromal development, and the mitosis-karyorrhexis index. However, diagnostic interpretation is challenged by intratumoral heterogeneity, sampling bias, interobserver variability, and the subjective assessment of subtle morphologic thresholds. These limitations directly influence prognostic categorization and subsequent clinical management. Digital pathology, through whole-slide imaging, provides a platform for standardized visualization and quantitative analysis of entire tumor sections. Recent computational and artificial intelligence-assisted approaches have demonstrated feasibility in tumor category classification, assessment of differentiation, automated mitosis-karyorrhexis index quantification, prognostic stratification, and prediction of molecular features such as MYCN amplification. While reported performance metrics are promising, most studies remain retrospective, single-institution studies, and limited by small pediatric datasets. Significant barriers to clinical translation persist, including the need for multi-institutional validation, workflow standardization, quality assurance frameworks, regulatory governance, and mitigation of algorithmic bias. Current evidence supports the role of digital and artificial intelligence tools as complementary aids rather than replacements for expert pathologist interpretation. Coordinated efforts addressing validation, infrastructure readiness, and ethical considerations will be essential for responsible integration of computational methods into neuroblastoma histopathology.

abstract: [Phytotherapy research : PTR] Plant-derived preparations remain widely used, yet their clinical application is constrained by multicomponent composition, batch-to-batch chemical variability, and complex pharmacokinetics, poorly characterized interactions, and marked interindividual variability in response. Artificial intelligence (AI) and computational pharmacology offer analytical tools suited to the high-dimensional data generated by phytomedicine, but enthusiasm has outpaced the supporting evidence. This critical narrative review evaluates AI applications across the phytomedicine pipeline, grading them by the strength and directness of evidence from computational prediction through in vitro, animal, observational, and randomized clinical studies. We organize the field around a Patient-Product-Mechanism-Response (PPMR) framework, arguing that meaningful personalization requires joint characterization of both the patient and the chemically variable botanical product. Current applications are most mature for botanical authentication, spectral annotation, quality assurance, and mechanism-informed hypothesis generation, whereas validated tools for patient stratification, individualized product and dose selection, and improved clinical outcomes remain limited. Rather than claiming efficacy gains, we present AI as a means to advance standardized, mechanism-informed, and testable phytomedicine, contingent on higher-quality data, prospective external validation, and regulatory alignment. The central finding is that none of the studies examined demonstrated a complete AI-guided personalized-phytomedicine pathway from joint patient-and-product characterization through a prospectively validated individualized response; precision phytomedicine should therefore be described as an emerging and hypothesis-generating research programme rather than an established clinical capability.
zh_abstract: [Phytotherapy research : PTR] 植物源制剂仍被广泛使用，但其临床应用受到以下因素限制：多成分组成、批次间化学差异、复杂的药代动力学、相互作用特征不明，以及个体间反应差异显著。人工智能（AI）和计算药理学为植物药产生的高维数据提供了适用的分析工具，但热情已超过现有证据支持。这篇批判性叙述性综述评估了AI在植物药全流程中的应用，并按证据的强度和直接性（从计算预测到体外、动物、观察性及随机临床研究）进行分级。我们围绕“患者-产品-机制-反应”（PPMR）框架组织该领域，认为有意义的个体化需要同时表征患者和化学成分多变的植物产品。目前的应用在植物鉴定、光谱注释、质量保证以及基于机制的假设生成方面最为成熟，而用于患者分层、个体化产品和剂量选择以及改善临床结局的经验证工具仍然有限。我们并不宣称疗效获益，而是将AI视为推动标准化、基于机制且可检验的植物药发展的手段，这有赖于更高质量的数据、前瞻性外部验证以及与监管的协调一致。核心发现是：所检视的研究中，没有一项展示了从患者和产品联合表征到经前瞻性验证的个体化反应的完整AI引导个体化植物药路径；因此，精准植物药应被描述为一个新兴的、产生假设的研究方向，而非已确立的临床能力。

title: Design of Highly Efficient pegRNAs with Minimized Off-Target Effects Using DeepPrime.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)
zh_title: 用DeepPrime设计高效低脱靶pegRNA
summary: 方法学章节，给出使用DeepPrime设计高效率、低脱靶pegRNA的分步实验方案。
key_points: 引导编辑无需双链断裂或供体模板
pegRNA效率取决于引导序列、PBS与RTT
提供DeepPrime设计流程的分步方案
reason: 方法学协议章节，无新验证数据，属增量档
abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Prime editors are newly developed genome editing tools capable of installing various types of mutations without introducing double-strand DNA breaks (DSBs) or requiring donor DNA templates. Prime editors consist of a Cas9 nickase fused to a reverse transcriptase (RT) domain and function as a ribonucleoprotein complex with prime editing guide RNA (pegRNA). Unlike the single guide RNA (sgRNA) used with Cas9 or base editors, the editing efficiency of pegRNAs is determined by the sequence composition and length of the guide sequence, primer binding site (PBS), and reverse transcription template (RTT). The high design flexibility of pegRNAs presents both opportunities and challenges. Therefore, designing pegRNAs with high efficacy has been a significant hurdle for the application of prime editing. Here, we present a step-by-step protocol for designing optimal pegRNAs to introduce desired edits using a deep learning-based algorithm, DeepPrime.

title: The digital health ecosystem in respiratory medicine: from traditional testing to real-world, artificial intelligence-powered monitoring and personalised care.
zh_title: 呼吸医学数字健康生态：从传统检测到AI监测
summary: 综述呼吸功能评估从实验室检测走向家庭与真实环境，介绍便携设备、可穿戴及AI在信号处理、质控和判读中的作用，并指出各技术成熟度差异。
key_points: 家用系统、便携设备与可穿戴支持连续监测
机器学习辅助信号处理与肺功能解读
各工具在生理细节与临床成熟度上不同
reason: 综述类，泛泛介绍，无新实证
abstract: [Breathe (Sheffield, England)] Lung function evaluation is rapidly evolving beyond laboratory testing. While conventional tests remain the clinical reference standard, digital health technologies now enable respiratory assessment at home and in real-world settings through home-based systems, portable devices, and wearables. These tools can support repeated or continuous monitoring of traditional and digital biomarkers of respiratory health and disease. However, they differ in physiological detail, usability, degree of patient involvement and clinical maturity. In parallel, artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming an important complement to these technologies. Machine learning and deep learning can support signal processing, quality control and interpretation of pulmonary function tests, while also extracting clinically relevant information from multimodal respiratory data collected outside controlled environments. Generative AI has a more emerging role, mainly in patient communication and educational support. For pulmonary function test interpretation, current evidence supports clinician-AI collaboration as the most realistic near-term model, rather than fully autonomous decision-making. This review summarises the main technologies currently available for lung function evaluation in adults and discusses the current and future role of AI in respiratory monitoring, interpretation and personalised care.
zh_abstract: [Breathe（英国谢菲尔德）] 肺功能评估正在迅速超越实验室检测的范畴。尽管传统检测仍是临床参考标准，数字健康技术如今已能通过家用系统、便携设备和可穿戴设备，在家庭和真实环境中进行呼吸评估。这些工具可支持对呼吸健康与疾病的传统和数字生物标志物进行重复或连续监测。然而，它们在生理学细节、可用性、患者参与程度和临床成熟度方面各不相同。与此同时，人工智能（AI）正成为这些技术的重要补充。机器学习和深度学习可支持肺功能检测的信号处理、质量控制和解读，并能从受控环境之外采集的多模态呼吸数据中提取临床相关信息。生成式AI的作用尚在起步阶段，主要用于患者沟通和教育支持。对于肺功能检测的解读，现有证据支持将临床医生与AI协作作为近期最现实的模式，而非完全自主的决策。本综述总结了目前可用于成人肺功能评估的主要技术，并讨论了AI在呼吸监测、解读和个体化医疗中的当前及未来作用。

title: Benchmarking Clinical Safety and Diagnostic Accuracy of Large Language Models in Otorhinolaryngology Emergencies: A Cross-Lingual Comparison of ChatGPT 5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro.
zh_title: ChatGPT 5.2与Gemini 3 Pro在耳鼻喉急症中的安全性与诊断对比
summary: 用30个模拟耳鼻喉病例，比较两种大模型在土耳其语和英语下的分诊准确性、临床安全性与急症识别表现。
key_points: 30个标准化模拟场景，专家共识为金标准
评估三级分诊准确率、安全评分与急症识别
比较土耳其语与英语的跨语言表现
reason: 仅30个模拟病例、探索性研究，属增量档
abstract: [Ear, nose, & throat journal] BackgroundWhile the clinical potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly recognised, their safety in morphologically rich languages remains debated. This exploratory study comparatively examines the ability of two recent artificial intelligence models, ChatGPT 5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro, to evaluate simulated otorhinolaryngology (ENT) cases across urgent, priority, and elective triage categories in Turkish and English.MethodsThe study was designed around 30 standardised clinical scenarios covering frequent ENT pathologies. Gold standard diagnosis and disease management decisions were determined by expert consensus. Model performance was evaluated in terms of three-category triage accuracy, clinical safety scores, and emergency-detection performance, using expert consensus decisions as the reference standard. Cohen's Kappa, Wilcoxon Signed Ranks, and McNemar tests were applied to measure inter-model and inter-language agreement.ResultsAll 120 model-generated primary diagnoses were confirmed as correct by the two ENT specialists. Correct triage classifications were obtained in 55/60 (91.7%) responses for ChatGPT 5.2 and 58/60 (96.7%) responses for Gemini 3 Pro. Agreement with expert-defined triage decisions was almost perfect (κ = 0.813-0.938). No statistically significant differences in the evaluated paired comparisons of triage accuracy or clinical safety scores were detected (all p > 0.05). Gemini 3 Pro correctly identified all 18 emergency scenarios in both language conditions.ConclusionsBoth models demonstrated high observed diagnostic and triage accuracy in a limited set of simulated ENT scenarios spanning different acuity levels. Although no statistically significant differences were detected in the evaluated comparisons, these findings do not establish equivalence between models or languages. These encouraging findings, particularly the high performance observed in Turkish, support further investigation of large language models as potential adjunctive clinical decision-support tools, while larger and more diverse clinical studies remain necessary before routine clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [Ear, nose, & throat journal] 【背景】尽管大语言模型（LLM）的临床潜力日益得到认可，但其在形态丰富语言中的安全性仍存争议。这项探索性研究比较了两种近期人工智能模型ChatGPT 5.2和Gemini 3 Pro，在土耳其语和英语中对紧急、优先和择期分诊类别的模拟耳鼻喉科（ENT）病例进行评估的能力。【方法】研究围绕涵盖常见耳鼻喉疾病的30个标准化临床场景设计。金标准诊断和疾病管理决策由专家共识确定。以专家共识决策为参考标准，从三类分诊准确率、临床安全性评分和急症识别表现方面评价模型性能。应用Cohen's Kappa、Wilcoxon符号秩检验和McNemar检验衡量模型间及语言间的一致性。【结果】两位耳鼻喉科专家确认全部120个模型生成的主要诊断均正确。ChatGPT 5.2在55/60（91.7%）的回答中、Gemini 3 Pro在58/60（96.7%）的回答中获得正确的分诊分类。与专家界定的分诊决策的一致性几乎完全（κ = 0.813-0.938）。在所评估的配对比较中，分诊准确率或临床安全性评分均未检出统计学显著差异（均P > 0.05）。Gemini 3 Pro在两种语言条件下均正确识别了全部18个急症场景。【结论】在涵盖不同急性程度的有限数量模拟耳鼻喉科场景中，两种模型均表现出较高的诊断和分诊准确率。尽管在所评估的比较中未检出统计学显著差异，但这些发现并不能证明模型之间或语言之间等效。这些令人鼓舞的发现，特别是在土耳其语中观察到的高表现，支持进一步研究将大语言模型作为潜在的辅助临床决策支持工具，而在常规临床应用之前，仍需开展更大规模、更多样化的临床研究。

title: Do Large Language Models Show Racial and Sex Bias in Pain Management? A Counterfactual Audit of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen
zh_title: 大模型在疼痛管理中是否存在种族与性别偏见：反事实审计
summary: 对 GPT、Claude、Gemini、Llama、DeepSeek、Qwen 等模型用急性疼痛病例做反事实审计，考察种族与性别偏见及输出不稳定性。
key_points: 研究 1 用四个开源模型，种族性别组合并以姓名提示
研究 2 覆盖 17 个模型 24 种配置
为探索性、非预注册分析
reason: 覆盖模型广的偏见审计，但为探索性预印本，无临床验证
abstract: Racial and ethnic minority patients receive less pain treatment than non-Hispanic White patients, and large language models (LLMs) used as medical AI could reproduce that bias. Prior audits tested a few proprietary models, stated race explicitly and rarely measured the models' own response instability. In exploratory, non-preregistered analyses, Study 1 had four open-weight LLMs assess six acute-pain vignettes in every combination of four races and two sexes, with identity stated or cued only by a name (two names per group), comparing each identity with a White male reference on the same case and sampling seed. In Study 2, 24 configurations of 17 models, including OpenAI's GPT-4.1 mini and gpt-oss, Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5, Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash, Meta's Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen, with reasoning on and off and at two precisions, answered the same vignettes and the 50 clinician-written Q-Pain cases. In this single-prompt, JSON-constrained task, no difference survived correction in Study 1, none of 1,386 comparisons survived the false discovery rate in Study 2, and every pain-severity difference was equivalent to zero within one point on a 0-10 scale (within a quarter point for 237 of 238 Q-Pain comparisons). Opioid decisions were bounded less precisely (Study 1 could not exclude differences of about 20 percentage points), so they show no detected difference, not proof of none. The few differences surviving correction within a model favoured Black patients. Models differed far more from one another and across their own settings than between patients (the reference patient received the high opioid dose in 6% to 93% of responses), although serving software, provider and prompt format also differed. Fairness audits of clinical AI should use several names per group, pair comparisons on the seed, report the noise floor and test each deployed configuration.
zh_abstract: 少数族裔患者接受的疼痛治疗少于非西班牙裔白人患者，而用作医疗人工智能的大语言模型（LLM）可能重现这种偏见。既往审计仅检测了少数几个专有模型，明确给出种族信息，且很少衡量模型自身响应的不稳定性。在探索性、非预先注册的分析中，研究1让四个开放权重LLM对六个急性疼痛病例情景进行评估，涵盖四种种族与两种性别的所有组合，身份或被明确陈述，或仅通过姓名提示（每组两个姓名），并在同一病例和同一采样种子下将各身份与白人男性参照进行比较。研究2中，17个模型的24种配置（包括OpenAI的GPT-4.1 mini和gpt-oss、Anthropic的Claude Haiku 4.5、Google的Gemini 2.5 Flash、Meta的Llama、DeepSeek和Qwen，分别开启和关闭推理，并采用两种精度）回答了相同的病例情景以及50个由临床医生编写的Q-Pain病例。在这一单提示、JSON约束的任务中，研究1中没有任何差异在校正后仍然成立；研究2的1,386项比较中没有任何一项通过错误发现率校正；且所有疼痛严重程度差异在0–10分量表上均等价于零（在1分以内；238项Q-Pain比较中有237项在0.25分以内）。阿片类药物决策的界值不够精确（研究1无法排除约20个百分点的差异），因此这只表明未检测到差异，而不能证明不存在差异。在单个模型内，校正后仍存在的少数差异对黑人患者有利。模型之间以及同一模型不同设置之间的差异远大于患者之间的差异（参照患者获得高剂量阿片类药物的响应比例在6%至93%之间），尽管所用服务软件、提供方和提示格式也有所不同。临床人工智能的公平性审计应为每组使用多个姓名，按种子配对比较，报告噪声底线，并检验每一种已部署的配置。

title: Supervision-Aware Evaluation of MedGemma for Reference-Assisted Radiotherapy Contour Ranking
zh_title: MedGemma 在放疗勾画排序中的监督感知评估
summary: 评估冻结的 MedGemma 1.5 用于放疗轮廓排序，显示监督读出内部表征优于输出概率，并在 SegRap2023 的 120 例迁移。
key_points: 12 例留出测试、30 例交叉拟合
最终状态读出较概率读出 AP 提高 0.3047
视觉 token 读出在迁移中进一步提升
reason: VLM 方法分析有对比与迁移测试，但样本小的预印本
abstract: Radiotherapy contour ranking can support quality assurance, but vision-language model (VLM) gains may reflect supervision, score construction, available inputs, or representation access. We evaluated frozen MedGemma 1.5 in a single-institution study, a 12-patient held-out HaN-Seg test, five-fold cross-fitting on 30 non-test HaN-Seg patients, and transfer without refitting to 120 SegRap2023 patients. On held-out HaN-Seg, a supervised readout of the final prompt state exceeded a supervised readout of the model's yes/no output probabilities by +0.3047 pooled average precision (AP; 95% patient-bootstrap interval [+0.2822, +0.3269]); the advantage persisted against a parameter-count-matched nonlinear control. A readout of projected visual tokens exceeded the final-state readout in cross-fitting and transfer (+0.0706 AP averaged equally across patients on SegRap; 95% interval [+0.0607, +0.0804]), while a structured panel-feature readout remained competitive with visual tokens. The anatomy-conditioned readout did not demonstrate an advantage over the native-feature comparator. These results motivate visual-token and structured-feature controls in medical-imaging VLM evaluations; outcomes were computational or synthetic, not clinical acceptability.
zh_abstract: 放疗轮廓排序可支持质量保证，但视觉-语言模型（VLM）的增益可能反映监督方式、评分构建、可用输入或表征获取方式。我们在一项单机构研究中评估了冻结的 MedGemma 1.5，包括 12 例患者的 HaN-Seg 留出测试集、对 30 例非测试 HaN-Seg 患者进行的五折交叉拟合（cross-fitting），以及不经重新拟合直接迁移至 120 例 SegRap2023 患者。在 HaN-Seg 留出测试集上，对最终提示状态（final prompt state）的有监督读出比对模型 yes/no 输出概率的有监督读出，汇总平均精度（AP）高 +0.3047（95% 患者自助法区间 [+0.2822, +0.3269]）；与参数量匹配的非线性对照相比，该优势依然存在。对投影后视觉 token 的读出在交叉拟合和迁移中优于最终状态读出（在 SegRap 上按患者等权平均，AP 高 +0.0706；95% 区间 [+0.0607, +0.0804]），而结构化的面板特征读出与视觉 token 相比仍具竞争力。以解剖结构为条件的读出未显示出优于原生特征对照的优势。这些结果提示，在医学影像 VLM 评估中应设置视觉 token 和结构化特征对照；所得结果为计算性或合成性结果，并非临床可接受性。

title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
zh_title: Breath-Dx：电子鼻疾病筛查时间序列分类基准
summary: 基于最大公开电子鼻数据集S-OH构建呼气疾病筛查基准，并显式考虑传感器漂移。
key_points: 含1,234名患者、九个诊断组
17通道多变量时间序列
采用考虑漂移的时间划分
reason: 新的公开基准且关注传感器漂移，但为预印本、领域较窄
abstract: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. We systematically evaluate 10 methods spanning four families: feature-based tabular learners, convolution-based models, graph-based, and time series architectures. All methods degrade significantly under temporal validation (0.05-0.12 AUC drop compared to random cross-validation), confirming that drift embeds a strong temporal signal. Under this realistic evaluation, the best methods achieve ROC AUC of 0.74-0.76 for some lung conditions, though others remain near chance. Recurrent architectures show the most consistent performance across diseases, while specialized time series methods achieve the highest peak results. Demographic confounders matter: breath signals provide independent diagnostic value for some conditions but add little beyond age for others. We release the S-OH dataset, all temporal splits, evaluation protocols, and code to enable reproducible research and accelerate progress in clinical breathomics.
zh_abstract: 电子鼻（eNose）技术通过呼出气分析，为疾病筛查提供了一条便携、无创的途径。然而，该领域的进展受到阻碍，原因在于缺乏在现实条件下比较机器学习方法的系统性基准，尤其是传感器漂移这一已知但鲜有量化的失效模式。现有大多数研究依赖规模较小的私有数据集，且方案不一致，导致结果无法比较并拖慢进展。我们提出 Breath-Dx，这是首个用于基于呼气的疾病筛查的时间序列分类方法综合基准。我们的工作利用 Scent of Health（S-OH）数据集，这是迄今最大的公开临床电子鼻数据集，包含九个诊断组共 1,234 名患者，每名患者提供一条 17 通道多变量时间序列，并设有考虑传感器漂移的明确时间性训练/测试划分。我们系统评估了涵盖四类的 10 种方法：基于特征的表格学习器、基于卷积的模型、基于图的方法以及时间序列架构。在时间性验证下，所有方法的性能均显著下降（与随机交叉验证相比 AUC 下降 0.05-0.12），证实漂移含有很强的时间信号。在这种现实评估下，最佳方法对部分肺部疾病的 ROC AUC 为 0.74-0.76，而其他疾病仍接近随机水平。循环架构在各疾病间表现最为稳定，而专门的时间序列方法取得了最高的峰值结果。人口统计学混杂因素很重要：呼吸信号对某些疾病具有独立的诊断价值，而对另一些疾病，除年龄之外几乎没有增加价值。我们发布了 S-OH 数据集、全部时间性划分、评估方案和代码，以促进可复现的研究并加速临床呼吸组学的进展。

title: Read and Ignore: What Self-Directed LLM Agents Do in Public Service Scenarios
zh_title: “读而不做”：自主LLM智能体在公共服务场景中的行为
summary: 在四个专家验证的公共服务场景中，对十个LLM收集2400条轨迹，考察指令不明确时智能体的自主决策行为。
key_points: 开放式运行中96.9%读取记录，仅18.7%产出成果
给出明确任务后产出率升至86.0%
领域上下文使边界探测轮次减少60%

abstract: Underspecified instructions leave LLM agents to decide what to do. In public services, staff write these instructions, but the agent's decisions affect residents, patients, and students. We build four expert-validated public-service scenarios with records and decision levers that can be checked in the files, collect $2{,}400$ trajectories from ten LLMs under four prompt conditions, and compare them with $1{,}000$ runs in a context-free sandbox. Agents read the records in $96.9\%$ of open-ended runs and produce an artifact or a self-chosen task in $18.7\%$; with an explicit task, $86.0\%$ produce. Domain context does not change how many runs produce ($18.7\%$ vs.\ $16.0\%$), and the production ranking of the models largely carries over (Spearman $0.79$), while the ranking by whether a model reads the records does not ($0.19$). Context cuts boundary-probing turns per run by $60\%$, and some artifacts contradict the records. We contribute a test that a public-service institution can run on its own records before procurement; its rule-based taxonomy needs no labeled data, and scenarios, code, and trajectories are released.
zh_abstract: 指令不完整时，大语言模型（LLM）智能体需自行决定要做什么。在公共服务领域，这些指令由工作人员撰写，但智能体的决策会影响居民、患者和学生。我们构建了四个经专家验证的公共服务场景，其中包含可在文件中核查的记录和决策杠杆；在四种提示条件下收集了十个 LLM 的 2,400 条轨迹，并与无上下文沙箱中的 1,000 次运行进行比较。在开放式运行中，智能体有 96.9% 会读取记录，18.7% 会产出制品或自行选定的任务；在给出明确任务时，86.0% 会产出。领域上下文并未改变产出运行的比例（18.7% 对 16.0%），模型在产出方面的排名也基本得以延续（Spearman 系数 0.79），而按模型是否读取记录得出的排名则不然（0.19）。上下文使每次运行中试探边界的轮次减少 60%，且部分制品与记录相矛盾。我们提供了一项公共服务机构可在采购前用自己的记录运行的测试；其基于规则的分类体系无需标注数据，场景、代码和轨迹均已公开。

abstract: Selective-review systems aim to reduce human review by passing candidates predicted to be low risk. However, coverage (the fraction passed) can be misleading when measurements needed to interpret risk are unavailable. We separate structural evaluability (a nonempty mask with all required measurements available), computational-endpoint status, and pass-or-review decisions using archived Mayo records and controlled OpenKBP analyses. In 3,968 Mayo records, all 1,167 recorded empty predictions (predicted target-organ masks containing zero voxels despite nonempty reference masks) were endpoint-negative and passed both modules, accounting for approximately 76% of each pass set. In a held-out OpenKBP test, a logistic-regression router achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.833 and average precision of 0.449 but passed all 544 non-evaluable candidates, including 542 prespecified empty-mask controls and 2 erosions that became empty. A structural gate removed those passes without changing scores or the threshold, preserved all evaluable passes, and assigned 98.71% of endpoint-positive candidates to review. Under the original preprocessing and in patient-disjoint development evaluation, a router trained only on evaluable candidates and a router modeling an unavailable state likewise passed no non-evaluable candidates, with similar evaluable discrimination and at least 99.0% of endpoint-positive candidates assigned to review in pooled outer-fold predictions. These results show that coverage should be interpreted jointly with candidate eligibility, endpoint scope, missingness handling, and routing rules; they do not establish clinical validity, deployment safety, or natural-failure prevalence.

title: DETER: Suppression During Pretraining for Tamper Resistance

summary: 在预训练中交错梯度上升以抑制医学知识，使开放权重模型更难通过对抗微调重获知识；1B 规模下所需 PubMed 微调 token 超过仅过滤的20倍。

abstract: Open-weight language models can acquire knowledge that could enable biological, chemical, or cyber misuse. Any attempt to limit such knowledge must remain effective after the model weights are released and can be fine-tuned. Unlearning applied after pretraining can be rapidly undone, whereas filtering the pretraining corpus offers greater resistance. We ask whether actively suppressing knowledge during pretraining can further increase the fine-tuning required to acquire it. Even simple gradient ascent interleaved with standard pretraining on the filtered corpus makes medical knowledge harder to acquire through adversarial fine-tuning than filtering alone or post-hoc unlearning. At 1B parameters, reaching the held-out PubMed loss of an unfiltered model requires over 20$\times$ as many PubMed fine-tuning tokens as after filtering alone. Retained knowledge is evaluated using both held-out data and downstream tasks. Across model sizes, varying suppression strength reveals an increasingly favorable trade-off between fine-tuning difficulty and held-out loss on retained pretraining data. These results point to pretraining as an effective stage for making unwanted capabilities harder to acquire through subsequent fine-tuning. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/MEGlr/DETER}{\texttt{github.com/MEGlr/DETER}}.
zh_abstract: 开放权重语言模型可能获得可被用于生物、化学或网络滥用的知识。任何限制此类知识的尝试，都必须在模型权重发布且可被微调之后仍然有效。预训练后进行的遗忘（unlearning）可被迅速撤销，而过滤预训练语料则具有更强的抵抗性。我们探讨在预训练期间主动抑制知识，是否能进一步增加获取该知识所需的微调量。即使是在过滤后语料上、与标准预训练交替进行的简单梯度上升，也比单纯过滤或事后遗忘更能使医学知识难以通过对抗性微调获得。在10亿参数规模下，要达到未过滤模型在留出 PubMed 数据上的损失，所需的 PubMed 微调 token 数是仅过滤情形的20倍以上。保留的知识通过留出数据和下游任务两种方式评估。在不同模型规模下，改变抑制强度表明，微调难度与保留的预训练数据上的留出损失之间的权衡越来越有利。这些结果表明，预训练是使不良能力更难通过后续微调获得的有效阶段。代码见 \href{https://github.com/MEGlr/DETER}{\texttt{github.com/MEGlr/DETER}}。

title: Discharge Summary Generation Is Not Just Summarization: A Reality Check for Evaluation
zh_title: 出院小结生成不只是摘要：证据感知的评估框架
summary: 提出FairSumEval，在事实层面评估出院小结中参考与生成内容是否有输入证据支持，区分匹配、遗漏与新增。
key_points: 区分有证据支持与仅参考端的事实

abstract: Discharge summaries combine a retrospective account of hospitalization with discharge-time decisions. Physician-written references therefore contain both facts supported by prior clinical notes and reference-only content, potentially reflecting clinical synthesis, handoffs, or discharge planning. Reference-only evaluation can conflate failure to recover available information with failure to reproduce content absent from the model input. We introduce FairSumEval, an evidence-aware, fact-level framework that assesses whether each reference and generated fact is supported by the model's evidence and captured by the other summary. The resulting outcome map separates matches, omissions, and additions. Two complementary metrics, Soft IoU-S and Soft IoU-NS, measure reference-generation agreement for facts with and without identified evidence support. On 200 MIMIC-III admissions, 18.8% of physician reference facts have identified support in the prior evidence, compared with 65.4% and 63.5% of facts generated by a general-purpose and a medically specialized model. Overlap is substantially higher for supported content (0.255 and 0.236) than for content without identified support (0.030 and 0.026). The two scores are weakly correlated across admissions (rho = 0.22 and 0.17), and conventional metrics do not consistently capture both dimensions. FairSumEval distinguishes evidence-grounded summarization from agreement on content without identified support, revealing what models omit and add in each category.
zh_abstract: 出院小结既包含对住院经过的回顾性叙述，也包含出院时的决策。因此，医师撰写的参考小结既包含有既往临床记录支持的事实，也包含仅见于参考小结的内容，后者可能反映临床综合判断、交接或出院计划。仅依据参考小结的评估可能将“未能还原已有信息”与“未能再现模型输入中不存在的内容”混为一谈。我们提出了 FairSumEval，这是一个具备证据意识的、基于事实层面的框架，用于评估每条参考事实和生成事实是否得到模型所用证据的支持，以及是否被另一份小结所涵盖。由此得到的结果图谱将匹配、遗漏和新增区分开来。两个互补指标 Soft IoU-S 和 Soft IoU-NS 分别衡量参考小结与生成小结在有已识别证据支持的事实和无已识别证据支持的事实上的一致性。在 200 例 MIMIC-III 住院病例中，医师参考小结中有 18.8% 的事实在既往证据中存在已识别的支持，而一个通用模型和一个医学专用模型生成的事实中这一比例分别为 65.4% 和 63.5%。有支持内容的重叠度（0.255 和 0.236）显著高于无已识别支持内容的重叠度（0.030 和 0.026）。这两个得分在各住院病例间仅呈弱相关（rho = 0.22 和 0.17），且传统指标并不能始终同时反映这两个维度。FairSumEval 区分了基于证据的摘要生成与对无已识别支持内容的一致性，从而揭示了模型在每一类别中遗漏和新增的内容。

title: Binding Mode Matters: Hotspot-Aware Drug Discovery via Explorative Preferences
zh_title: BindMol：基于热点感知与探索性偏好的药物发现

abstract: Discovering hit molecules requires not just high binding affinity, but also the identification of diverse binding modes, which are critical for experimental assays. Existing generative approaches have predominantly relied on optimizing a scalar docking score, obscuring the distinct contributions of key binding determinants. To this end, we introduce a paradigm shift by formulating target-based drug design as a multi-objective exploration task, where each objective explicitly corresponds to enhancing interactions with a specific hotspot. Here, we introduce BindMol, a novel generative framework driven by a customized multi-objective reinforcement learning algorithm. By incorporating explorative preferences during training, our approach efficiently uncovers molecules with diverse and desirable binding profiles. Empirical results demonstrate that BindMol facilitates the discovery of high-affinity compounds characterized by both structural novelty and diverse binding modes. Validated across target-based drug discovery and multi-property optimization tasks, our approach provides a versatile paradigm for goal-oriented drug discovery.

title: Multimodal protein representations across human brain cell types
zh_title: SEMPER：跨人脑细胞类型的多模态蛋白表征
summary: 提出多模态模型 SEMPER，将蛋白语言模型表征与442种成人脑细胞类型的蛋白互作网络对齐，为每个蛋白生成细胞类型相关表征。
key_points: 对齐蛋白语言模型与细胞类型特异PPI网络
覆盖成人脑442种细胞类型
针对脑组织在单细胞图谱中占比小的问题
reason: 新颖的预印本方法，摘要中证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: The central nervous system (CNS) comprises diverse cell types whose molecular context shapes the roles of the proteins they express. Computational models offer a scalable way to study the roles of proteins across human brain cell types, with protein language models and interactome- or single-cell-based models capturing complementary information encoded in protein sequences and cellular network contexts. Human brain tissue is hard to access, so brain cell types make up a small fraction of the atlases single-cell models train on and of the benchmarks used for their evaluation. To capture these complementary sources of information in the CNS, we introduce SEMPER, a multimodal representation learning model that aligns protein language model representations with protein-protein interaction networks from 442 cell types of the adult human brain, giving each protein a sequence-informed representation in every cell type in which its gene is expressed. We show that SEMPER representations predict cell type-specific protein complexes and predict genes essential to the survival of dopaminergic neurons, measured in a genome-wide CRISPR screen. In zero-shot retrieval, SEMPER recovers clinically pursued drug targets for Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, Huntington's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis at higher rates than cell type-specific models. To further improve target recovery, we combine SEMPER with a large language model that reasons over protein functional annotations. The combination recovers more targets, with SEMPER providing experimentally derived cellular context that complements literature-based reasoning of the large language model.

title: Network scaling in swarm learning across real hospitals of different sizes: a KPI-driven analysis on the eICU Collaborative Research Database

abstract: Background. Distributed learning lets hospitals train prediction models jointly without exchanging patient records, but how the benefits of a swarm network change as it grows, and which hospitals gain most, have so far been studied with artificial partitions of single-center databases. We examined network scaling on real hospitals that differ in size, volume and sepsis prevalence. Methods. We applied the seven-KPI swarm-learning evaluation framework (Swarm Gain, Local Gain, Relative Local Gain, Model Stability Index, Jain's index, Data Utility Index and label entropy) to progressive network scaling on the eICU Collaborative Research Database. From 25 hospitals (71,887 ICU stays; sepsis prevalence 16.6%), six hospitals stratified by bed size (two small, two medium, two large; 14,776 stays) formed networks of two, four and six hospitals in all six category-joining orders; four further hospitals served as substitutes in robustness checks. Swarm learning was simulated with the client-controlled workflow of NVIDIA FLARE (federated averaging, 30 rounds, five random seeds). The task was whole-stay sepsis classification from discretized vital-sign, laboratory and medication features with a 1,313-parameter feedforward network, with AUROC as the metric. Results. Substituting alternative medium or large hospitals left network AUROC between 0.790 and 0.805. Conclusions. zh_abstract: 【背景】分布式学习使医院能够在不交换患者记录的情况下联合训练预测模型，但群体（swarm）网络的获益如何随规模扩大而变化、哪些医院获益最大，迄今仅在单中心数据库的人为划分上进行过研究。我们在规模、病例量和脓毒症患病率各不相同的真实医院上考察了网络扩展。【方法】我们将包含七项 KPI 的群体学习评估框架（Swarm Gain、Local Gain、Relative Local Gain、Model Stability Index、Jain 指数、Data Utility Index 和标签熵）应用于 eICU Collaborative Research Database 上的渐进式网络扩展。在 25 家医院（71,887 次 ICU 住院；脓毒症患病率 16.6%）中，按床位规模分层选取 6 家医院（2 家小型、2 家中型、2 家大型；14,776 次住院），以全部六种类别加入顺序组成 2 家、4 家和 6 家医院的网络；另有 4 家医院在稳健性检验中作为替代医院。群体学习使用 NVIDIA FLARE 的客户端控制工作流模拟（联邦平均，30 轮，5 个随机种子）。任务为基于离散化的生命体征、实验室和用药特征，使用具有 1,313 个参数的前馈网络对整个住院期间的脓毒症进行分类，指标为 AUROC。【结果】在所有排序中，网络 AUROC 随每次加入医院而升高，2 家医院时分别为 0.734（小型优先）、0.755（中型优先）和 0.781（大型优先），6 家医院时为 0.804（SD 0.002）。在全部 9 种不同的转变中 Swarm Gain 均超过 1（2 家到 4 家的平均值为 1.042，4 家到 6 家为 1.020）。所有医院的 Local Gain 均低于 1；相对于本地训练的相对改善幅度，最强医院（本地 AUROC 0.773）为 4.1%，最弱医院（0.621）为 29.5%，小型医院平均 25.5%，大型医院平均 5.9%。加入大型医院使现有成员获益最大（平均 Relative Local Gain +6.2%）；加入小型医院从未使其降低。种子间变异性的变异系数由 2 家医院时的 2.2% 降至 6 家医院时的 0.2%。各医院间特征分布近乎一致（Data Utility Index 0.005–0.013），而标签熵的变化与 Swarm Gain 相关（r = 0.74）。替换为其他中型或大型医院后，网络 AUROC 保持在 0.790 至 0.805 之间。【结论】在真实多医院数据上，群体学习的参与改善了每家医院的模型，本地模型最弱的医院获益最大，且没有任何一次加入对网络造成损害（原文截断）。

abstract: [PLOS digital health] Artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are being explored to deliver health coaching across multiple contexts. However, the quality and safety of chatbot-generated advice is influenced by how prompts are constructed, and prompt design remains inconsistently described in the literature. This scoping review examined how prompt design has been applied and evaluated in AI health coaching chatbots and summarized the study designs, prompt strategies, and outcomes reported across studies. We conducted a scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidance and searched PubMed, Embase/Ovid MEDLINE ALL, PsycINFO, IEEE Xplore, and Scopus for peer-reviewed studies published up to October 2025. Eligible studies examined prompt design in large language model-based health coaching chatbots. Data were extracted using a standardized form and synthesized narratively. Twelve studies were included, spanning mental health, medication use, physical activity, and nutrition contexts. Study designs were primarily simulation-based, with few involving real users. Prompt strategies were grouped into structural modifications, prompting techniques, and role-based approaches. Structural modifications, such as increasing specificity and adding constraints, were most common and were reported to improve response quality and clarity. Prompting techniques were reported to improve task performance but sometimes reduced focus or consistency. Role-based prompting influenced tone, specificity, and guideline alignment. Outcomes focused mainly on response quality, with fewer studies assessing safety or user experience and only one evaluating clinical outcomes. Prompt design is a key, modifiable determinant of chatbot performance. However, current evidence is limited by heterogeneous study designs and minimal real-world evaluation. Greater focus on prompt design is needed to improve the quality and safety of AI-delivered health coaching and its real-world impact on health outcomes.

abstract: [Annals of surgical oncology] Whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) can identify publishable scientific work is untested. This study evaluated whether GPT-4.1 mini could distinguish Society of Surgical Oncology (SSO) posters that reached full-text publication using poster content alone and examined characteristics associated with conversion. This study retrospectively analyzed 597 posters from the 2022-2023 SSO Annual Meetings. Each poster was scored by GPT-4.1 on five research-quality domains during 30 runs at temperature zero. Discrimination was assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Multivariable logistic regression tested whether the score added information beyond poster and investigator characteristics. Of 597 posters, 295 (49.4%) reached full-text publication. The composite score showed modest discrimination (AUC, 0.62; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.57-0.66), with no evidence that performance differed across categories (interaction P = 0.90). Each 5-point increase in score was associated with higher adjusted odds of publication (odds ratio [OR], 1.45; 95% CI, 1.21-1.75), and adding the score to poster characteristics improved discrimination (ΔAUC, 0.05; 95% CI, 0.01-0.08). Design rigor, data quality, conclusion validity, and publication potential scores were associated with publication, but novelty was not. Multicenter status, first-author training status, and author sex were not significantly associated with publication. Lower adjusted odds for Hispanic first authors did not persist after multiplicity correction (OR, 0.35; 95% CI, 0.15-0.81). The GPT-4.1 mini scores modestly distinguished posters that reached publication and added information beyond poster characteristics. Multimodal large language models merit further study as instruments for examining and strengthening scholarly work rather than as arbiters of publishability.

abstract: [Nihon Hoshasen Gijutsu Gakkai zasshi] To evaluate how output format affects inference accuracy in contrast-enhanced CT protocol generation using a large language model (LLM) combined with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based on information obtained from a radiology information system. A total of 335 contrast-enhanced CT examinations with radiologist-determined protocols were retrospectively analyzed. Among them, 292 cases were used to build the RAG knowledge base, and 43 cases were used for validation. Two types of prompts were prepared: a structured format that outputs each imaging phase (unenhanced, arterial, portal venous, and equilibrium) in binary form (0/1), and a free-text format. The inference results generated by each format were evaluated. Complete agreement across all imaging phases was achieved in 16 of 43 cases (37.2%). Phase-specific accuracies were 76.2% for the unenhanced phase, 64.3% for the arterial phase, 78.6% for the portal venous phase, and 81.0% for the equilibrium phase. In the free-text evaluation, 65.1% of the generated contrast-enhanced CT protocols were rated as either "no issues" or "acceptable." An LLM integrated with RAG may serve as a potential decision-support tool for determining contrast-enhanced CT protocols.

abstract: [Zeitschrift fur Orthopadie und Unfallchirurgie] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has become an established part of medical education and postgraduate training. Large language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT are widely used for information retrieval, structuring complex content, and preparing clinical cases-often in an informal manner, without didactic guidance and without a clear understanding of how these systems function. For orthopedics and trauma surgery (O&T), a specialty characterized by high decision density and direct responsibility for patient safety, the key question is therefore no longer whether generative AI is used, but how it should be integrated. This article analyzes current patterns of use and highlights a central discrepancy: widespread adoption contrasts with heterogeneous levels of competence. Generative AI can support the structuring of learning processes, simulate elements of clinical reasoning, and assist educators in developing teaching materials. At the same time, LLMs generate responses on a probability-based foundation and do not perform their own evidence verification. Plausible but incorrect information, loss of clinical context, or bias may influence diagnostic reasoning and undermine evidence-based decision-making. In a safety-critical field such as O&T, this necessitates clear orientation and professional standards. The core of the article is the development of a discipline-specific framework for the integration of generative AI into undergraduate and postgraduate education. This framework combines an understanding of how generative AI systems operate with didactic responsibility, quality assurance, and a clear delineation of medical decision-making authority. Generative AI is positioned consistently as a supportive tool, not as a substitute for clinical expertise. Particular emphasis is placed on structured prompting as a key competence. The ability to formulate precise clinical questions, make contextual information explicit, and critically compare AI-generated outputs with guidelines and scientific literature is described as an integral component of contemporary medical professionalism. In addition, the article proposes a practice-oriented guideline for students, residents, and educators. abstract: [Reproduction (Cambridge, England)] Fertilisation in mammals is preceded by a multilayered selection process shaped by more than 600 million years of evolution. The female reproductive tract acts as a sequential filter-through vaginal pH, cervical mucus, the uterotubal junction, the isthmic sperm reservoir, the cumulus matrix and the zona pellucida-such that only a few hundred capacitated, structurally and molecularly competent spermatozoa reach the ampulla. Intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), introduced in 1992, bypasses these filters. Advanced techniques-including IMSI, physiological ICSI (PICSI), magnetic-activated cell sorting (MACS), microfluidic sorting and deep-learning image classification-aim to restore part of this discriminatory capacity in the laboratory. Systematic reviews and current professional guidance indicate that none has produced a robust improvement in cumulative live birth in unselected assisted-reproduction populations, although ESHRE considers microfluidic selection an option. This review maps each technique to the in vivo filter it purports to mimic, evaluates the clinical evidence, considers long-term follow-up of ICSI-conceived offspring and imprinting-disorder surveillance, and asks whether targeted, mechanism-based selection in defined subgroups could succeed where unselected use has not. Evidence from non-human mammals-colloid and microfluidic selection in horses and cattle, sex-sorted semen, species differences in ICSI efficiency and mouse ICSI with DNA-damaged spermatozoa-is used to test the framework where human data are observational only. The evolutionary perspective is used as a design framework: for each technique, it identifies the mechanism to be recapitulated and the maternal, pregnancy and offspring outcomes by which benefit and safety should be judged.

abstract: [Multiple sclerosis and related disorders] Early diagnosis and intervention are crucial in multiple sclerosis (MS), yet diagnostic delays are common. Large language models (LLMs) such as generative pre-trained transformers (GPTs) may streamline diagnostic workflows by extracting MS diagnostic signals from clinical notes. To derive MS diagnosis status from the first neurology note using a computable algorithm based on the 2017 McDonald criteria and applying GPT-4 for node-level reasoning within a structured decision framework. We analyzed the first neurology notes from 125 randomly selected patients (people with MS, related disorders, and controls) enrolled in a clinic-based cohort between 2017 and 2023. We included the clinical history and diagnostic testing sections but redacted the assessment and plan. We converted the 2017 McDonald criteria into a decision tree and provided expert-curated clinical knowledge to guide GPT-4 reasoning at each decision node. GPT-4 generated binary decisions at each node to traverse the tree and assign MS diagnoses at terminal nodes. We evaluated performance against neurologist-assessed diagnoses and characterized hallucination types (non-factual, incongruent, irrelevant, over-reliant, and logical reasoning errors). In this study cohort (mean age 40±12 years; 81% women) representative of the clinic population, GPT-4 performed well in predicting MS diagnosis (84% accuracy, 79% precision, 74% recall, 91% specificity) using first neurology notes. Hallucinations occurred in 32 cases (26%), most commonly incoherence (75%) and overreliance (47%). A structured, LLM-guided decision framework can identify MS diagnoses from early clinical documentation. Large-scale studies are needed to mitigate hallucinations, validate this approach, and test implementation in clinical settings.
zh_abstract: [多发性硬化及相关疾病] 早期诊断和干预对多发性硬化（MS）至关重要，但诊断延误很常见。生成式预训练转换器（GPT）等大语言模型（LLM）可通过从临床记录中提取MS诊断信号来简化诊断流程。本研究旨在基于2017年McDonald标准，利用可计算算法，并在结构化决策框架内应用GPT-4进行节点级推理，从首次神经科就诊记录中得出MS诊断状态。我们分析了2017年至2023年间纳入某门诊队列的125名随机选取患者（MS患者、相关疾病患者及对照）的首次神经科就诊记录。纳入病史和诊断检查部分，但对评估与计划部分予以遮蔽。我们将2017年McDonald标准转换为决策树，并提供专家整理的临床知识以指导GPT-4在各决策节点的推理。GPT-4在每个节点生成二元决策以遍历决策树，并在终末节点给出MS诊断。我们以神经科医生评估的诊断为参照评价其性能，并对幻觉类型（非事实性、不一致、无关、过度依赖及逻辑推理错误）进行了特征描述。在这一能代表该门诊人群的研究队列中（平均年龄40±12岁；81%为女性），GPT-4利用首次神经科就诊记录预测MS诊断的表现良好（准确率84%，精确率79%，召回率74%，特异度91%）。32例（26%）出现幻觉，最常见的是不连贯（75%）和过度依赖（47%）。结构化的、由LLM引导的决策框架可以从早期临床文书中识别MS诊断。需要开展大规模研究以减少幻觉、验证该方法，并在临床环境中检验其实施。

summary: 以斋月禁食为模型，用面部视频评分追踪禁食与补水状态转变；104名参与者评分由36.6升至70.6。
