abstract: Hydration influences physiology and daily function, yet repeated practical measurement in everyday settings remains limited. We present initial real-world evidence that a facial-video lifestyle digital biomarker score can track the direction of hydration state transitions. Using Ramadan fasting as a model of prolonged fluid abstinence, we assessed whether the score tracks the transition between the fasting (pre-drink) state and the rehydrated (post-drink) state across three validation layers. In the primary cohort (104 participants, 208 videos), the score increased from a mean of 36.6 in the fasting (pre-drink) state to 70.6 in the rehydrated (post-drink) state (change = +33.9, 95% CI [+30.7, +37.1], p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 2.03), with 102 of 104 participants (98.1%) showing an upward shift. In a nested body-weight subgroup (20 participants), body weight increased by +0.74 kg after fluid intake (p < 0.001), confirming fluid uptake and providing supportive physical anchoring. In a nested serum osmolality subgroup (10 participants), osmolality decreased by -5.1 mOsm/kg (p < 0.001), with all post-drink values within the normal clinical range, providing exploratory biological support. An exploratory secondary comparison of water versus electrolyte rehydration showed no statistically significant difference in short-term score change (p = 0.247). This study does not establish a clinical diagnostic test for dehydration. Rather, these findings support the score as a lifestyle digital biomarker for tracking the direction of hydration state change in real-world settings.
zh_abstract: 水合状态影响生理和日常功能，但在日常环境中进行重复的实用测量仍然有限。我们提供了初步的真实世界证据，表明面部视频生活方式数字生物标志物评分可以追踪水合状态转变的方向。我们以斋月禁食作为长时间不摄入液体的模型，在三个验证层面评估该评分是否能追踪禁食（饮水前）状态与补水（饮水后）状态之间的转变。在主要队列（104名参与者，208段视频）中，评分由禁食（饮水前）状态的平均36.6升至补水（饮水后）状态的70.6（变化=+33.9，95% CI [+30.7, +37.1]，p < 0.001，Cohen's d = 2.03），104名参与者中有102名（98.1%）出现上升。在嵌套的体重亚组（20名参与者）中，摄入液体后体重增加0.74 kg（p < 0.001），证实了液体摄入，并提供了支持性的物理锚定。在嵌套的血清渗透压亚组（10名参与者）中，渗透压下降5.1 mOsm/kg（p < 0.001），所有饮水后数值均在正常临床范围内，提供了探索性的生物学支持。一项探索性的次要比较显示，水与电解质补水在短期评分变化上无统计学显著差异（p = 0.247）。本研究并未建立用于脱水的临床诊断检测。相反，这些发现支持该评分可作为一种生活方式数字生物标志物，用于在真实环境中追踪水合状态变化的方向。

title: AToP: An Explainability Framework for Transformer-Based EHR Predictions Using Attribution-Guided Temporal Pattern Mining

summary: 提出事后解释框架，将Transformer的逐token积分梯度转为结构化时序模式叙述，在MIMIC-IV再入院预测上评估。

abstract: Objective: To develop and evaluate AToP (Attribution to Temporal Patterns), a post-hoc explainability framework that converts per-token Integrated Gradients (IG) from a Transformer into structured temporal pattern narratives. Materials and Methods: AToP was applied to a single-stream Transformer trained on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (218,196 patients; 12.6% unplanned 30-day readmission). It mines frequent episodes from salient-token subsequences in the training cohort, aggregates attribution among patients whose records contain each token or pattern, and collapses near-duplicates by patient overlap. Validation used masking, reversed-order analysis, token-level faithfulness tests, and KernelSHAP comparison. Results: The Transformer achieved AUROC 0.77 and PR-AUC 0.34. Population-weighted attribution emphasized high-prevalence codes with small per-patient impact. Carrier-conditional attribution, the mean among patients with the token, surfaced rare high-attribution psychiatric markers including psychosis, self-harm overdose, suicidal ideation (SI), and severe major depressive disorder (MDD). Pattern-level attribution identified within-visit co-occurrences and cross-visit trajectories not captured by token rankings. Risk-increasing patterns included psychiatric sequences ({MDD, SI} [->] SI) and oncologic progressions (cancer anemia [->] ascites). Obstetric and chest pain evaluation patterns were associated with lower predicted readmission. Discussion: The framework provides two complementary views of model predictions: carrier-conditional aggregation highlights rare, highly attributed clinical features, while temporal pattern analysis identifies within-visit combinations and cross-visit trajectories missed by token-level rankings. Masking and visit-order reversal provided evidence of correspondence with model behavior, but pattern attributions do not represent unique effects or establish clinical validity. Conclusion: AToP turns a Transformer's attributions into visit-anchored temporal pattern narratives, showing which events, in which order, contribute to its readmission predictions.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并评估 AToP（Attribution to Temporal Patterns，归因至时间模式），这是一种事后可解释性框架，可将 Transformer 的逐 token 积分梯度（Integrated Gradients，IG）转换为结构化的时间模式叙述。【材料与方法】将 AToP 应用于在 MIMIC-IV v3.1 上训练的单流 Transformer（218,196 名患者；非计划 30 天再入院率为 12.6%）。该方法从训练队列中显著 token 子序列中挖掘频繁情节，在其记录包含每个 token 或模式的患者中汇总归因，并按患者重叠度合并近似重复项。验证采用了掩码、顺序反转分析、token 级忠实性检验以及与 KernelSHAP 的比较。【结果】该 Transformer 的 AUROC 为 0.77，PR-AUC 为 0.34。按人群加权的归因强调高流行率编码，其对单个患者的影响较小。携带者条件归因（即具有该 token 的患者中的均值）则凸显出罕见的高归因精神科标志物，包括精神病、自伤性过量用药、自杀意念（SI）和重度抑郁症（MDD）。模式层面的归因识别出了 token 排名未能捕捉到的同次就诊内共现和跨就诊轨迹。风险升高的模式包括精神科序列（{MDD, SI} [->] SI）和肿瘤进展（癌性贫血 [->] 腹水）。产科和胸痛评估模式与较低的预测再入院风险相关。【讨论】该框架提供了模型预测的两种互补视角：携带者条件聚合突出罕见但高归因的临床特征，而时间模式分析则识别出 token 级排名所遗漏的同次就诊内组合和跨就诊轨迹。掩码和就诊顺序反转提供了与模型行为相对应的证据，但模式归因并不代表独特效应，也不能确立临床有效性。【结论】AToP 将 Transformer 的归因转化为以就诊为锚点的时间模式叙述，展示了哪些事件以何种顺序对其再入院预测产生贡献。

title: MENTOR: An Evidence-Informed Large Language Model-Based Multi-Agent System for Efficient Selection of Institution-Specific Negative Control Outcomes
zh_title: MENTOR：基于LLM多智能体的机构特异性阴性对照结局选择
summary: MENTOR用四个LLM智能体结合CEM证据，在OMOP通用数据模型上辅助选择观察性研究的阴性对照结局，以减少人工筛选。

结合CEM证据与LLM推理
基于OMOP数据模型，面向机构特异性

abstract: Objective Negative control outcomes (NCOs) help detect and correct systematic error in observational studies, yet their selection remains largely manual. The Common Evidence Model (CEM) can generate candidate lists, but researchers must still screen them for plausibility as true nulls and for sufficient observation in each institution's data. We developed and evaluated MENTOR (Multi-agent Evidence-informed Negative conTrol Outcome selection with Reasoning), a multi-agent system of large language models (LLMs) that combines CEM evidence with LLM reasoning to select institution-specific NCOs. Methods Four LLM agents operate on an institution's Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership common data model. A Curator summarizes drug labels, a Suggester assesses locally frequent candidates with CEM evidence and a first-pass LLM judgment, an Adjudicator resolves their disagreements, and a Diagnostician relaxes the patient-count threshold until a target number of NCOs is met. Using Qwen3.6-27B, we evaluated 349 candidates for three drug pairs in a Korean tertiary hospital's electronic health records (2.9 million patients) against a blinded LLM judge from a different model family, validated by three experts on 90 candidates. We compared accuracy, positive predictive value (PPV), and sensitivity with CEM-only and first-pass-LLM-only selection. Results MENTOR proposed 243 NCOs versus 121 by CEM-only, with higher accuracy (0.83 [0.79-0.87] vs. 0.53 [0.48-0.58]), sensitivity (0.89 vs. 0.41), and PPV (0.86 vs. 0.79). Judge-expert agreement was {kappa}=0.63. Adjudication, needed for 44.1% of candidates, added little accuracy, and only with reasoning mode. Concordant acceptances, which bypass it, contained about half of the false positives. Only 7%-9% of CEM-proposed outcomes had at least 10,000 patients at the institution. Conclusion Combining LLM judgments with CEM evidence and local data yielded more NCOs, with higher PPV, than CEM alone. Restricting reasoning to discordant candidates kept computation time below 40% of that with reasoning in all agents. Every decision comes with its evidence and rationale for investigators' final review.
zh_abstract:
【目的】阴性对照结局（NCO）有助于发现并校正观察性研究中的系统误差，但其选择在很大程度上仍依赖人工。通用证据模型（Common Evidence Model，CEM）可以生成候选列表，但研究者仍须逐一筛查，以确认其作为真正零效应结局的合理性，以及在各机构数据中是否有足够的观察量。我们开发并评估了 MENTOR（Multi-agent Evidence-informed Negative conTrol Outcome selection with Reasoning），这是一个由大语言模型（LLM）组成的多智能体系统，将 CEM 证据与 LLM 推理相结合，以选择特定机构的 NCO。
【方法】四个 LLM 智能体基于机构的观察性医疗结局合作组织（Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership）通用数据模型运行。Curator 汇总药品说明书；Suggester 结合 CEM 证据和首轮 LLM 判断，评估本地常见的候选结局；Adjudicator 解决二者之间的分歧；Diagnostician 逐步放宽患者数阈值，直至达到目标 NCO 数量。使用 Qwen3.6-27B，我们在一家韩国三级医院的电子健康记录（290 万名患者）中，针对三个药物对评估了 349 个候选结局，并以来自不同模型家族的盲法 LLM 评判者作为参照，该评判者经三位专家对 90 个候选结局的验证。我们比较了其与仅用 CEM 及仅用首轮 LLM 选择方式的准确率、阳性预测值（PPV）和敏感度。
【结果】MENTOR 提出了 243 个 NCO，而仅用 CEM 为 121 个；其准确率更高（0.83 [0.79-0.87] 对 0.53 [0.48-0.58]），敏感度更高（0.89 对 0.41），PPV 也更高（0.86 对 0.79）。评判者与专家的一致性为 κ=0.63。44.1% 的候选结局需要经过裁决，裁决对准确率的提升很小，且仅在推理模式下才有提升。绕过裁决的一致接受的候选结局中，约含一半的假阳性。CEM 提出的结局中，在本机构至少有 10,000 名患者的仅占 7%-9%。
【结论】将 LLM 判断与 CEM 证据及本地数据相结合，所得 NCO 数量多于单独使用 CEM，且 PPV 更高。将推理限定于存在分歧的候选结局，可使计算时间低于所有智能体均使用推理时的 40%。每项决策均附有证据和理由，供研究者最终审核。

abstract: [Journal de mycologie medicale] Dermatophytosis is one of the most common superficial fungal infections worldwide. However, its diagnosis and management remain challenging because its clinical manifestations often overlap with those of other dermatoses, conventional mycological tests have inherent limitations, the disease is prone to recurrence, and antifungal resistance has received increasing attention. This review summarizes current applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in dermatophytosis, with a focus on the use of machine learning and deep learning in clinical photographs, non-invasive skin imaging, and laboratory diagnostics, while also discussing their roles in treatment support, follow-up assessment, patient education, and adherence management. In addition, with the accumulation of molecular diagnostic, mass spectrometric, and epidemiological data, AI may also provide auxiliary support for extended applications such as resistance risk recognition. Current evidence suggests that AI can improve the efficiency, consistency, and objectivity of dermatophytosis diagnosis and provide quantitative support for treatment response assessment and long-term follow-up. With further improvement in research quality and the accumulation of clinical application experience, AI is expected to become increasingly integrated into dermatophytosis management workflows.
zh_abstract: [真菌医学杂志（Journal de mycologie medicale）] 皮肤癣菌病是全球最常见的浅表真菌感染之一。然而，其诊断和管理仍具挑战性：其临床表现常与其他皮肤病重叠，传统真菌学检测存在固有局限，该病易复发，并且抗真菌耐药问题日益受到关注。本综述总结了人工智能（AI）在皮肤癣菌病中的当前应用，重点关注机器学习和深度学习在临床照片、无创皮肤影像及实验室诊断中的应用，同时讨论其在治疗支持、随访评估、患者教育和依从性管理中的作用。此外，随着分子诊断、质谱和流行病学数据的积累，AI 还可能为耐药风险识别等拓展应用提供辅助支持。现有证据表明，AI 可提高皮肤癣菌病诊断的效率、一致性和客观性，并为治疗反应评估和长期随访提供量化支持。随着研究质量的进一步提高和临床应用经验的积累，AI 有望日益融入皮肤癣菌病的管理流程。

abstract: Liver disease remains a major global health concern, highlighting the need for reliable and accessible early detection methods. Although recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and quantum machine learning (QML) have introduced promising diagnostic tools, many approaches suffer from limited interpretability and inflated performance caused by data leakage or overly simplistic evaluation protocols. These constraints reduce their reliability in real-world clinical practice. This paper proposes KQML-Liver, a hybrid framework that integrates QML with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance predictive performance and interpretability. The architecture combines parameterized quantum circuits for expressive feature representation with KAN-based functional mappings that capture nonlinear relationships in an interpretable manner. Evaluated on the Indian Liver Patient Dataset (ILPD) under a rigorous preprocessing protocol preventing data leakage, the proposed model achieves 82% classification accuracy and 100% recall, detecting all positive cases, outperforming existing baselines while providing improved transparency in clinical predictions. These results suggest that hybrid KAN-quantum architectures offer a promising direction for interpretable AI-assisted medical diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 肝病仍是全球主要的健康问题，凸显了对可靠且易于获得的早期检测方法的需求。尽管机器学习、深度学习和量子机器学习（QML）的最新进展带来了有前景的诊断工具，但许多方法存在可解释性有限，以及因数据泄漏或评估方案过于简化而导致性能被高估的问题。这些局限降低了它们在真实临床实践中的可靠性。本文提出 KQML-Liver，一种将 QML 与 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）相结合的混合框架，以提升预测性能和可解释性。该架构将用于表达性特征表示的参数化量子线路，与以可解释方式捕捉非线性关系的基于 KAN 的函数映射相结合。在采用防止数据泄漏的严格预处理方案的情况下，于印度肝病患者数据集（ILPD）上进行评估，所提模型达到 82% 的分类准确率和 100% 的召回率，检出了所有阳性病例，优于现有基线，同时提高了临床预测的透明度。这些结果提示，混合 KAN-量子架构为可解释的 AI 辅助医学诊断提供了一个有前景的方向。

abstract: Academic, psychosocial, financial, environmental, and interpersonal factors are widely recognized as important contributors to the overall wellbeing of students. This study aimed to identify factors associated with the psychological wellbeing of university undergraduates and compare the performance of machine learning models for binary and multiclass classification of wellbeing status using self-reported survey data from undergraduates at the University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka. The findings may facilitate the early identification of students with lower wellbeing and inform targeted interventions to foster a healthier and more supportive academic environment. Cross-sectional questionnaire data from 2,913 undergraduates were analyzed to classify psychological wellbeing using overall happiness scores. Scores were grouped into binary (1-5 and 6-9) and multiclass (1-4, 5-6, and 7-9) categories. Data preprocessing included missing value imputation, one-hot encoding, and feature scaling where appropriate. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost (XGB), and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) models were trained using repeated stratified 10-fold cross-validation and evaluated using macro F1-score, ROC-AUC, and classification reports. SHAP analysis was employed to interpret feature contributions and enhance model interpretability. XGB achieved the highest macro-F1 score (70.5%) for binary classification, with a test accuracy of 72.5%. The model correctly classified 63.6% and 80% of participants in the lower and higher psychological wellbeing groups, respectively. For multiclass classification, RF achieved the highest macro-F1 score (54.6%), with a test accuracy of 56.5%. The model correctly classified 48%, 57%, and 60% of participants in the lower, intermediate, and higher psychological wellbeing groups, respectively. SHAP analysis identified academic coping, health and wellbeing, financial circumstances, and interpersonal relationships as key predictors of psychological wellbeing across both models. These findings demonstrate the potential of machine learning to classify psychological wellbeing groups using self-reported data, supporting early identification of students at risk of poor wellbeing and informing targeted university-level mental health interventions.
zh_abstract: 学业、心理社会、经济、环境和人际因素被广泛认为是影响学生整体幸福感的重要因素。本研究旨在利用斯里兰卡佩拉德尼亚大学本科生的自报告调查数据，识别与大学本科生心理幸福感相关的因素，并比较机器学习模型在幸福感状态二分类和多分类中的表现。研究结果可能有助于早期识别幸福感较低的学生，并为有针对性的干预提供依据，以营造更健康、更具支持性的学术环境。研究分析了2,913名本科生的横断面问卷数据，利用总体快乐评分对心理幸福感进行分类。评分被分为二分类（1–5与6–9）和多分类（1–4、5–6和7–9）类别。数据预处理包括缺失值填补、独热编码，并在适当情况下进行特征缩放。采用重复分层10折交叉验证训练支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost（XGB）和多层感知机（MLP）模型，并使用宏平均F1分数、ROC-AUC和分类报告进行评估。采用SHAP分析解释特征贡献并增强模型可解释性。在二分类中，XGB取得最高的宏平均F1分数（70.5%），测试准确率为72.5%；该模型对心理幸福感较低组和较高组参与者的正确分类率分别为63.6%和80%。在多分类中，RF取得最高的宏平均F1分数（54.6%），测试准确率为56.5%；该模型对心理幸福感较低、中等和较高组参与者的正确分类率分别为48%、57%和60%。SHAP分析表明，学业应对、健康与幸福感、经济状况和人际关系是两个模型中心理幸福感的关键预测因素。这些结果表明，机器学习有潜力利用自报告数据对心理幸福感组别进行分类，有助于早期识别幸福感不佳风险的学生，并为有针对性的大学心理健康干预提供依据。
